title: Pure Fortune Lady
summary: Fortune Lady cards only, with staples and an automatic Extra Deck. Fortune Ladies are Spellcasters whose ATK/DEF come from their Level, and they gain a Level in every Standby Phase up to 12. The 2019 cards lead. Fortune Lady Calling summons a Fortune Lady with a different name from the Deck. Fortune Lady Past, the archetype's Tuner, banishes other Spellcasters to raise or lower a Fortune Lady's Level and set up any Synchro. Fortune Vision searches any Fortune Lady card, and Fortune Lady Rewind brings banished ones back. Fortune Lady Light summons another from the Deck when an effect moves it off the field, and Fortune Lady Water draws two when it joins another. Fortune Lady Fire, summoned in Attack Position by a Fortune Lady card, destroys a monster and burns for its ATK. Fortune Lady Every grows each Standby Phase and banishes a monster.
